resumeText:
JAMES CARTWRIGHT
Sydney, NSW | 0400 111 222 | james.cartwright@example.com
Australian Citizen - full working rights

SUMMARY
Career-changer moving from retail management into frontend development. Completed a full-time coding bootcamp and built several personal projects using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with growing experience in React. Bring strong communication and problem-solving skills from six years leading retail teams, now applying them to building user-friendly web interfaces.

SKILLS
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Git, Responsive Design, Basic Node.js

EXPERIENCE

Store Manager - Northside Menswear, Sydney
03/2018 - 01/2023
Managed day-to-day operations of a retail store including rostering, stock control and customer service.
- Trained and supervised a team of 8 sales staff across weekday and weekend shifts.
- Handled customer complaints and escalations, maintaining store reputation.
- Coordinated with head office on seasonal promotions and visual merchandising.
- Oversaw stocktake and inventory ordering processes.
- Opened and closed the store, including cash handling and banking procedures.
- Organised staff schedules to cover public holidays and peak trading periods.
- Ran weekly team meetings to discuss sales targets and store presentation.
- Liaised with suppliers regarding delivery schedules and stock issues.

Assistant Manager - Northside Menswear, Sydney
06/2015 - 03/2018
Supported the store manager in daily operations and staff supervision.
- Assisted with rostering and stock replenishment.
- Covered management duties during manager's absence.
- Helped train new casual staff on POS systems and customer service standards.

Sales Assistant - Northside Menswear, Sydney
02/2013 - 06/2015
- Provided customer service on the shop floor.
- Processed sales transactions and returns.
- Restocked shelves and maintained store presentation standards.

Junior Frontend Developer (Bootcamp Capstone) - CodeForge Academy, Sydney
02/2023 - 07/2023
Full-time intensive program covering modern frontend development.
- Learned HTML, CSS, JavaScript fundamentals and React through weekly projects.
- Improved the loading experience of a group project by optimising asset usage.
- Collaborated with a team of four using Git for version control on a shared repository.
- Presented final capstone project to a panel of industry mentors.

PROJECTS

Recipe Finder App
A React application that lets users search for recipes by ingredient and save favourites to local storage.
- Built with React, JavaScript and CSS Grid for a responsive layout.
- Improved the search experience by adding debounced input handling.

Personal Budget Tracker
A simple web app for tracking monthly expenses and visualising spending categories.
- Built with HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, using Chart.js for graphs.
- Refactored the codebase midway through the project to improve readability.

Retail Roster Planner
A tool concept inspired by scheduling problems from previous retail experience, built to practice React state management.
- Allows managers to input staff availability and generate a weekly roster.
- Focused on clean UI and form validation.

EDUCATION

Diploma of Retail Management
Sydney Business Institute, Sydney
2012 - 2013

Full Stack Web Development Bootcamp
CodeForge Academy, Sydney
02/2023 - 07/2023
- Covered HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Git fundamentals.

REFEREES
Available on request.
